## 📝 Key Tips
- **Most local** to Chermside & North Lakes: **Koolik & Associates** (North Lakes) and **Kelly Lawyers** (Ascot/Northside).
- Several firms offer **No Win, No Fee** for Family Provision Applications, including Attwood Marshall Lawyers and Will and Estate Lawyers Australia.
- Always check whether the firm has a **physical Northside presence** vs. operating remotely/online, as some Brisbane CBD firms can still serve Northside clients effectively.
- For FPAs in Queensland, strict **9-month time limits** apply from the date of death, so it's important to act quickly.
